naming_convention: snake_case. Monetary in AED. Ratios as decimal unless _pct suffix (0–100 scale).

formula_rules.od_pct: ALWAYS: od_aed ÷ ms_due_itd_aed × 100. NEVER: od_aed ÷ purchase_price_aed × 100.
formula_rules.channel_share_pct: ALWAYS: txn_count basis. NEVER: AED value basis.
formula_rules.npv_scenario: ALWAYS label 652M / 21M / 31M as [PROJECTED]. NEVER label as Actual.
formula_rules.cy_mix: CY = advance on milestones due current calendar year. FY = future-year milestones.
formula_rules.mdo_vs_finance: MDO Dues = Dues-only. Finance Dues = D+A combined. Label explicitly in every metric display.
formula_rules.pipeline: PIPELINE_GROSS 43.5B ≠ PIPELINE_FORWARD_BOOK ~40B ≠ PIPELINE_ADV_DENOM 37.8B. Always inline-label the specific constant in use.
formula_rules.units_count: active_excl_pcc = 30,044. all_qualified_itd = 34,731. Always label which is in use.

metrics.name: sale_value_itd
metrics.label: Group Sale Value ITD
metrics.formula: SUM(sale_value_aed) across all active + cancelled bookings
metrics.description: Total contracted sale value of all bookings ITD. Includes active and cancelled units. Group = AED 86.0B.

metrics.name: active_sale_value_itd
metrics.label: Active Portfolio Sale Value ITD
metrics.description: Sale value of non-cancelled active bookings only. Group = AED 86.97B (R36 Active sheet).

metrics.name: collected_itd
metrics.label: Collected ITD
metrics.formula: SUM(collected_aed) across all receipt categories ITD
metrics.description: Total receipts collected ITD across all categories. Group = AED 43.3B.

metrics.name: collected_itd_pct
metrics.label: % Collected ITD
metrics.description: Proportion of total sale value collected to date. Group = 50.3%.

metrics.name: future_milestone_pipeline
metrics.label: Future Milestone Pipeline
metrics.formula: SUM(forward_obligation_aed) for all future collection years from R36
metrics.description: Total forward receivables from all active bookings. Three variants with distinct scopes — always use named constant with inline label.

metrics.name: qualified_units
metrics.label: Qualified Units
metrics.formula: COUNT(unit_id) WHERE paid_pct >= 9.5% AND pcc_issued = false
metrics.description: Active booking units with ≥9.5% collected and PCC not yet issued.
metrics.rule: Always label which variant is displayed.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate_pct
metrics.label: Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Portfolio cancellation rate by value. 16.7B cancelled / 103.4B total sold = 16.1%.

metrics.name: dues_advance_total
metrics.label: Dues + Advance (D+A)
metrics.description: Core collections KPI. Excludes New Sales, DLD, Other Charges. 2025 Group = AED 12,966M.
metrics.disambiguation: Finance target includes D+A combined. MDO tracks dues and advance separately. Label which definition is in use.

metrics.name: total_collections
metrics.label: Total Collections
metrics.description: All receipts across all categories. 2025 Group = AED 16,820M. Sobha = 14,064M; Siniya = 2,506M; DT = 250M.

metrics.name: da_cagr
metrics.label: D+A Collections CAGR 2021–2025
metrics.description: 4-year CAGR for Dues+Advance. AED 867M (2021) → AED 12,966M (2025) = 97%.

metrics.name: da_growth_multiple
metrics.label: D+A Growth Multiple
metrics.description: 2021→2025 = 15×. Total collections = 10.7×. LP charges = 22×.

metrics.name: mix_pct_dues
metrics.label: Dues Mix % of Total Collections
metrics.description: Dues share of total collections. Tracks structural shift from dues-heavy to advance-balanced portfolio.

metrics.name: mix_pct_advance
metrics.label: Advance Mix % of Total Collections
metrics.description: Advance share of total collections. Rising trend 2021–2025.

metrics.name: mix_pct_new_sales
metrics.label: New Sales Mix % of Total Collections
metrics.description: New sales share of total collections. 2026 YTD significantly below target (31% achievement).

metrics.name: mdo_fy_dues_target
metrics.label: MDO FY Dues Target
metrics.description: Full-year MDO dues-only target. AED 11.5B.

metrics.name: achievement_pct
metrics.label: Achievement % (Actual ÷ Target)
metrics.description: Universal KPI for collector-level and entity-level performance. Context determines which target definition is used.

metrics.name: mdo_dues_target_monthly
metrics.label: MDO Monthly Dues Target
metrics.description: Dynamic MDO dues-only monthly target. Jan = 700.5M. Adjusted mid-year.
metrics.disambiguation: MDO Dues ≠ Finance Dues. Finance (R04) Jan = 909M. Both must be labelled on-screen.

metrics.name: finance_dues_target_monthly
metrics.label: Finance Monthly Dues Target (D+A Combined)
metrics.description: Finance monthly target = Dues + Advance combined (static). Jan = 909M.
metrics.disambiguation: Finance target ≠ MDO Dues target. Label explicitly: 'Finance Dues (D+A combined)'.

metrics.name: mdo_advance_target_fy
metrics.label: MDO FY Advance Target
metrics.description: Full-year MDO advance target. AED 4.0B.

metrics.name: q1_achievement_summary
metrics.label: Q1 2026 Achievement vs MDO
metrics.formula: Separate computation per category: actual ÷ MDO target × 100
metrics.description: Q1 2026 actuals vs MDO targets. Dues 1.92B/2.11B = 91%. Advance 702M/960M = 73%. NS 473M/1.52B = 31% (critical gap).
metrics.display_rule: S02 context = 'Year-to-Date Summary (Strategic)'. S03 context = 'Q1 Actuals vs MDO (Operational Pulse)'. Same source — different framing.

metrics.name: od_today
metrics.label: OD Today
metrics.formula: SUM(od_aed) from R18 at last refresh date
metrics.description: Current overdue balance. Group = 1,650.1M. Sobha=1,472.7M; Siniya=166.4M; DT=11.0M.
metrics.rule: Always read from OD_TODAY constant. Never hardcode. Changes daily.

metrics.name: od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate (Delinquency %)
metrics.description: OD as % of milestones due ITD. Group CIV total = 3.88%.
metrics.CRITICAL_rule: Denominator = ms_due_itd_aed. NEVER purchase_price_aed. Old formula (÷PP) understates delinquency.

metrics.name: efficiency_30d_pct
metrics.label: 30-Day Collection Efficiency
metrics.description: Dues collected in the month as % of opening book. 2025 average = 34.8%. Deprecated value of 18% from v3 is WRONG.

metrics.name: march_collectible_window
metrics.label: March Collectible Window
metrics.description: Total collectable in March: OD 1,650.1M + ~914M milestones = ~2,564M.

metrics.name: eom_od_projection
metrics.label: End-of-Month OD Projection
metrics.description: Projected EOM OD if no further collections in current month.

metrics.name: coverage_pct_by_bucket
metrics.label: Agent Coverage % by Bucket
metrics.description: Units contacted out of units allocated per collector bucket.

metrics.name: siniya_coverage_gap
metrics.label: Siniya Coverage Gap
metrics.description: 198 units unworked = 319M OD pool uncontacted.

metrics.name: bucket_productivity_pct
metrics.label: Bucket Productivity %
metrics.description: Collections yield per bucket. FE=44.1%, OD=35.4%, Term=27.2%. Lives in S03 (pulse metric, not S04 definition).
metrics.section_rule: S03 only — pulse metric. NOT in S04.

metrics.name: daily_mdo_avg
metrics.label: Daily MDO Average (Dues)
metrics.description: Daily MDO run-rate required. Uses WORKING_DAYS_MONTH constant (March=21, not hardcoded 22).
metrics.rule: NEVER hardcode working days. Always use WORKING_DAYS_MONTH variable.

metrics.name: collector_achievement_pct
metrics.label: Collector Achievement %
metrics.description: Individual collector performance. Chart sorted descending by achievement%. Top: Walid 56% (39.2M/70M), Abdellatif 54.8%, Sarmad 47.9%. Bottom: Ainur 29.5%, Oksana 32.1%.
metrics.display_rule: Chart must be sorted descending by achievement_pct. v5 is UNSORTED — fix in v6.
metrics.data_currency: Mar 2026 MTD snapshot. Label 'Snapshot: Mar 2026 MTD'. No live refresh.

metrics.name: termination_gap_exposure
metrics.label: Termination Unactioned Gap
metrics.description: 412 units not actioned in termination system = AED 134.6M OD exposure.

metrics.name: cy_advance_mix_pct
metrics.label: CY Advance Mix %
metrics.description: CY advance as % of total advance per month. Jan 2025 = 70.1% (NOT 30% — that was FY%). 2026 YTD = 81.1%. Computed once as CY_ADV_MIX_YTD constant.
metrics.rule: Compute ONCE as global constant CY_ADV_MIX_YTD. Reference in S01/S03/S05 — never recompute per-section.

metrics.name: fy_advance_mix_pct
metrics.label: FY Advance Mix %
metrics.description: FY advance as % of total advance. Complement of CY mix. Jan 2025 = 29.9%.

metrics.name: book_penetration_pct
metrics.label: Advance Book Penetration %
metrics.description: Annual advance collected as % of opening forward book. 2025 = 8.15% (÷40B). 2026 target = 10.6% (÷PIPELINE_ADV_DENOM 37.8B).
metrics.denominator_rule: PIPELINE_ADV_DENOM = 37.8B for 2026. NEVER use 43.5B for this metric. Definition lives once in S05 DEFINITION_BLOCK.

metrics.name: advance_lead_time_days
metrics.label: Avg Advance Lead Time (Days)
metrics.description: Average days advance is collected before milestone due date. Historical average = 248 days.

metrics.name: npv_rebate_rate_pct
metrics.label: NPV Rebate Rate %
metrics.description: Effective rebate rate on advance collected. Current NPV 3.5%; proposed 4.3%; bank equivalent 4.75%. 2026 YTD effective rate = 1.4% (9.14M on 641M).

metrics.name: npv_incremental_inflow
metrics.label: NPV Incremental Inflow [PROJECTED]
metrics.description: Incremental advance inflow from rebate programme modelled at proposed 4.3% rate. ~AED 652M.
metrics.CRITICAL_label_rule: ALWAYS display as [PROJECTED]. NEVER as Actual. This is a proposal model scenario.

metrics.name: ic_threshold_exposure
metrics.label: IC Threshold Exposure (0–10% Paid)
metrics.formula: SUM(sale_value_aed) WHERE paid_band = '0-10%' AND ic_threshold_eligible = true
metrics.description: Portfolio at risk under current IC threshold policy. 251 units / 907.7M sale value at 0–10% paid.
metrics.governance: IC threshold change (20%→10%) requires standalone board business case. Platform flags advisory only — policy not decided here.

metrics.name: skyvue_concentration_risk
metrics.label: Skyvue Cluster Concentration Risk
metrics.description: Skyvue project cluster: 535 units / 1.27B at 10–20% paid — high concentration risk.

metrics.name: paid_band_distribution
metrics.label: Portfolio Paid Band Distribution
metrics.formula: COUNT(units) and SUM(sale_value_aed) grouped by paid_band
metrics.description: Full portfolio segmented by % of purchase price paid. Key IC and risk heat map metric.

metrics.name: entity_monthly_collection
metrics.label: Entity Monthly Collections vs MDO
metrics.formula: SUM(actual_aed) per entity per month; achievement_pct = actual ÷ target × 100
metrics.description: Entity-level monthly performance. MDO Q1: Sobha 91%; Siniya 100.3%; DT 133%.

metrics.name: siniya_finance_performance
metrics.label: Siniya Finance Target Performance
metrics.description: Siniya Finance target performance. Jan: target 144.8M, actual 180.9M = 125%.

metrics.name: ns_target_gap
metrics.label: New Sales Collection Gap
metrics.description: New Sales critical underperformance. Q1 actual 473M vs target 1,520M = 31%. Jan actual 231M vs 507M target = 46%.
metrics.alert: CRITICAL GAP — flag in S03 Performance Flags INSIGHT_BLOCK

metrics.name: pr_approval_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR First-Pass Approval Rate %
metrics.description: Payment Receipts approved on first submission without rework. Dec 2025 (n=1,818): 51% approved. Drives AED 250–300M visibility gap from uncommitted PRs.

metrics.name: pr_doc_gap_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR Rejection Rate — Document Gaps
metrics.description: PRs rejected for missing/incorrect documentation. Dec 2025 = 27%. Target = 0% via Interim PR Module (P1 roadmap).

metrics.name: pr_manual_error_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR Rejection Rate — Manual Errors
metrics.description: PRs rejected due to data entry or processing errors. Dec 2025 = 23%.

metrics.name: pcc_tat_days
metrics.label: PCC Turnaround Time (TAT)
metrics.description: Calendar days from 100% payment to PCC issuance. Pre-initiative = 20d. Post-initiative (Q4 2025+) = 3–5d. Target = 2d.

metrics.name: pr_to_soa_tat_0_2d_pct
metrics.label: PR-to-SOA Turnaround % in 0–2 Days
metrics.description: PRs processed with SOA updated within 2 days. 2024=25%; 2025=35%; 2026 YTD=51%.

metrics.name: app_payment_share_pct
metrics.label: App Payment Channel Share %
metrics.description: One Sobha App share of all D+A payment transactions by COUNT. 2024=0.1%; 2025=6%; 2026 YTD=25.9%.
metrics.CRITICAL_rule: COUNT basis only. Do not use AED value for this metric.

metrics.name: helpdesk_within_tat_pct
metrics.label: Helpdesk Cases Resolved Within TAT %
metrics.description: Helpdesk cases closed within SLA. 2026 YTD = 85.5% (120,700 cases closed). Feb 2026 peak = 93.4%.

metrics.name: call_audit_coverage_pct
metrics.label: Call Audit Coverage %
metrics.description: QCG audit coverage of outbound collector calls. Current = 30%. Target = 100% via AI-Driven Audit (P3, Q1 2027).

metrics.name: sla_tat_compliance_pct
metrics.label: SLA TAT Compliance %
metrics.description: All operational tasks completed within defined SLA. Current = 87%. Target = 90%.

metrics.name: dld_forfeiture_ytd
metrics.label: 2026 YTD DLD Forfeiture
metrics.formula: SUM(dld_forfeiture_aed) WHERE year = 2026 AND month <= current_month
metrics.description: 2026 YTD DLD forfeiture = 38.9M already exceeds full-year 2025 (22.3M). Critical acceleration flag.
metrics.alert: 38.9M YTD > full-year 2025 — flag in S06 INSIGHT_BLOCK

metrics.name: nationality_od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate by Nationality
metrics.description: OD rate by customer nationality. India = 4.33% (272M OD, highest absolute); Iran = 9.14% (highest rate); Russia = 2.36%; China = 1.73%; Netherlands = 10.02%.

metrics.name: civ_od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate by CIV Band
metrics.description: OD rate by Customer Investment Value tier. Group total = 3.88% (1,650M / 42,505M MS Due). Peak: 60–100M band = 31.58%.

metrics.name: lp_growth_multiple
metrics.label: LP Charges Growth Multiple
metrics.description: Late payment charges growth 2021→2025. 1.54M → 34.82M = 22× growth. Delinquency proxy signal.

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Single metric M049 with benchmarks: pre=20d / current=3-5d / target=2d

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Single M016 — used at entity, collector, and MDO level with context-appropriate target
Single CY_ADV_MIX_YTD global constant — computed once, referenced 3× never recalculated

resolved_conflicts.resolution: M006 defines both variants explicitly; label rule enforced

resolved_conflicts.conflict: od_pct used purchase_price denominator in v1–v3 metrics
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Corrected to ms_due_itd_aed throughout; deprecated formula documented

resolved_conflicts.resolution: M020 used in both — framing labels differentiate: Strategic (S02) vs Operational Pulse (S03)
